shared/src/messages.rs.description: ServerPayload enum uses tagged serde serialization (#[serde(tag = "type", content = "data")]). PanicStop response variants added: PanicStopActivated (timeout_secs: u32), PanicStopStatus (remaining_ms: u64, active: bool), PanicStopTriggered (symbol only).

server/src/server.rs.description: PanicStopState struct added at module level with fields: symbol (Symbol), side (Side), timeout_ms (u64), trigger_price (Option<Decimal>), last_trade_time (Instant), active (bool). Connection state maintained as Option<PanicStopState> alongside chart_subscription in handle_connection function.
